name: DUMBBELL JUMPING LUNGE
introduce: Start in a lunge position with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. \n\nJump up and quickly switch legs. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Make sure your front knee won\'t go over your toes.
Exhale as you jump up, and inhale as you land.
This exercise strengthens your quadriceps, glutes and hamstrings.
